story.iWant: REST API endpoints for worker monitoring
story.soThat: the Next.js frontend can display Celery worker health, logs, and metrics without requiring direct Celery or Kubernetes access
story.tasks:
### Backend Implementation (8 tasks) - Task 1: Create `src/api/workers.py` FastAPI router with 4 endpoint stubs - Task 2: Define Pydantic DTOs in `src/schemas/worker.py` (6 schemas) - Task 3: Create `src/services/worker_service.py` with Celery inspect integration - Task 4: Implement `GET /api/workers` endpoint (list workers) - Task 5: Implement `GET /api/workers/{hostname}/logs` (fetch K8s logs) - Task 6: Implement `POST /api/workers/{hostname}/restart` (K8s rollout restart) - Task 7: Implement `GET /api/workers/{hostname}/metrics` (Prometheus queries) - Task 8: Add `@require_role("admin")` RBAC decorator to all endpoints
### Testing (5 tasks) - Task 9: Write unit tests for `WorkerService` class (mock Celery, K8s, Prometheus) - Task 10: Write integration tests for all 4 endpoints (`test_worker_api.py`) - Task 11: Test error handling (401, 403, 404, 503 scenarios) - Task 12: Test with real Celery workers in local Docker Compose environment - Task 13: Verify OpenAPI docs generated correctly at `/docs`
### Configuration & Dependencies (3 tasks) - Task 14: Add `kubernetes>=28.0.0` to `pyproject.toml` dependencies - Task 15: Add Kubernetes config loading to `src/config.py` (settings.k8s_namespace, settings.prometheus_url) - Task 16: Update `src/main.py` to include workers router (`app.include_router(workers.router)`)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
AC-1: GET /api/workers - List All Workers - Returns array of WorkerStatusDTO objects with hostname, status (active/idle/unresponsive), uptime, active_tasks, completed_tasks, CPU/memory metrics, throughput - Response time < 2 seconds - Error handling: 401 (not authenticated), 403 (non-admin), 503 (Redis/Celery unavailable)
AC-2: GET /api/workers/{hostname}/logs - Fetch Worker Logs - Returns array of log entries with timestamp, level, message, task_id - Query parameters: lines (max 1000, default 100), since (ISO 8601) - Fetches from Kubernetes pod logs API - Error handling: 404 (worker not found), 400 (invalid params), 503 (K8s unavailable)
AC-3: POST /api/workers/{hostname}/restart - Restart Worker - Triggers Kubernetes rollout restart for worker pod - Logs action to audit_log table with user_id, action, resource, timestamp - Returns HTTP 202 Accepted with restart_initiated_at timestamp - Error handling: 404 (worker not found), 403 (non-admin), 500 (K8s command fails)
AC-4: GET /api/workers/{hostname}/metrics - Fetch Detailed Metrics - Returns WorkerMetricsDTO with current metrics (CPU, memory, network), 7-day throughput history (hourly), uptime, Celery/Python versions - Data sources: Prometheus (current metrics + history), Celery inspect (metadata) - Error handling: 404 (worker not found), 503 (Prometheus unavailable), graceful degradation for partial data
AC-5: RBAC Enforcement - Admin Only - All 4 endpoints require "admin" role via `@require_role("admin")` decorator - HTTP 403 Forbidden for non-admin users
AC-6: Tenant Isolation Not Required - Worker monitoring is global admin function - No X-Tenant-ID header required - All workers visible to all admins
AC-7: OpenAPI Documentation Generated - All 4 endpoints visible at `/docs` under "Workers" tag - Request/response schemas documented via Pydantic models
AC-8: Integration Tests Pass - test_list_workers_success, test_list_workers_unauthorized - test_get_logs_success, test_get_logs_invalid_lines - test_restart_worker_success, test_restart_worker_not_found - test_get_metrics_success, test_get_metrics_prometheus_down

story-context.constraints: - C1: File size limit 500 lines → workers.py (≤150 lines), worker_service.py (≤300 lines), worker.py schemas (≤100 lines) - C2: Use existing auth system → @require_role("admin") decorator from src/api/dependencies.py - C3: No tenant isolation for infrastructure endpoints → Worker monitoring is global admin function - C4: Prometheus as metrics source → Query existing Prometheus deployment for CPU/memory metrics - C5: Kubernetes Python library → kubernetes>=28.0.0 for pod log fetching and restart - C6: HTTPX for Prometheus queries → Async HTTP client for /api/v1/query and /api/v1/query_range - C7: FastAPI OpenAPI auto-documentation → Pydantic schemas generate docs at /docs - C8: Audit logging required for restart action → Log to audit_log table with user_id, action, resource, timestamp - C9: Response time <2s for list endpoint → Use caching if needed, optimize Celery inspect calls - C10: Graceful degradation if Prometheus unavailable → Return cached data or partial metrics, don't fail entirely

tests.standards: - Use pytest + pytest-asyncio for async test support - Mock Celery inspect API responses using unittest.mock - Mock Kubernetes API client for pod logs and restart operations - Mock Prometheus query responses for metrics endpoints - Target ≥80% code coverage for service layer and API routes - Use FastAPI TestClient for API endpoint testing - Follow AAA pattern: Arrange, Act, Assert - Include success cases, error cases (404, 401, 403, 503), and edge cases
tests.locations: - tests/unit/test_worker_service.py - Service layer unit tests - tests/unit/test_worker_api.py - API endpoint unit tests - tests/integration/test_worker_integration.py - End-to-end integration tests with live Celery workers
tests.ideas:
AC-1: List Workers - test_list_workers_success: Returns worker list with status, metrics, uptime - test_list_workers_no_workers: Handles empty worker list (inspect returns None) - test_list_workers_unauthorized: Returns 403 for non-admin users - test_list_workers_service_unavailable: Returns 503 when Celery/Redis unavailable
AC-2: Get Worker Logs - test_get_logs_success: Returns log entries with pagination (limit, offset) - test_get_logs_filtered_by_level: Filters by log level (DEBUG, INFO, ERROR) - test_get_logs_filtered_by_time: Filters by start_time and end_time - test_get_logs_worker_not_found: Returns 404 for invalid worker hostname - test_get_logs_invalid_params: Returns 400 when lines > 1000
AC-3: Restart Worker - test_restart_worker_success: Returns 202 with restart_initiated_at timestamp - test_restart_worker_graceful: Waits for active tasks to complete - test_restart_worker_force: Kills active tasks immediately - test_restart_worker_audit_logged: Verifies entry in audit_log table - test_restart_worker_not_found: Returns 404 for invalid worker - test_restart_worker_kubernetes_failure: Returns 500 when K8s API fails
AC-4: Get Metrics - test_get_metrics_success: Returns CPU, memory, throughput from Prometheus - test_get_metrics_prometheus_unavailable: Returns 503 or gracefully degrades - test_get_metrics_historical_data: Returns 7-day hourly throughput history
AC-8: Integration Tests - test_e2e_list_restart_workflow: List workers → Restart → Verify restarted - test_e2e_real_celery_workers: Test with live Docker Compose workers
